title: Add admin user and admin panel for managing bookings

requirements.text: Add a hardcoded admin principal to the backend. The website owner's Internet Identity principal should be stored as the designated admin. Expose a backend query `isAdmin(caller)` that returns true if the caller's principal matches the admin principal. Expose a protected `getAllBookings` query that only returns data to the admin principal and rejects all other callers.
acceptanceCriteria: A single admin principal is hardcoded in the backend actor.
getAllBookings returns booking data only when called by the admin principal.
Non-admin callers receive an authorization error from getAllBookings.
An isAdmin query returns true only for the admin principal.

requirements.text: Add an admin panel page to the frontend accessible only after logging in with Internet Identity. After login, check the backend isAdmin function; if true, show the admin dashboard. The dashboard must display a table of all submitted bookings with columns: booking ID, service type, booking category, customer name, phone number, preferred date, message, and status. Include a login button using Internet Identity for access. If the logged-in user is not admin, show an 'Access Denied' message.
acceptanceCriteria: An /admin route or admin section is accessible from the site (e.g., via a hidden nav link or direct URL).
The page shows a 'Login with Internet Identity' button when the user is not authenticated.
After successful Internet Identity login, the frontend calls isAdmin and shows the bookings table if true.
The bookings table displays all fields: ID, service type, category, name, phone, date, message, status.
Non-admin authenticated users see an 'Access Denied' message.
The admin panel matches the existing cosmic/mystical visual theme.

constraints: Admin identity must be verified using Internet Identity (no username/password).
Do not expose getAllBookings to unauthenticated or non-admin callers.
Do not modify frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts or frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts.
Do not modify any paths listed in frontend.immutablePaths.
nonGoals: Admin ability to edit or delete bookings (view only).
Email or push notification on new booking.
Any external authentication provider other than Internet Identity.
